recents.value: type == 'XCUIElementTypeButton' AND label == 'Recents' AND visible == 1 AND accessible == 1

recents-selected.value: type == 'XCUIElementTypeButton' AND label == 'Recents' AND selected == 1 AND visible == 1 AND accessible == 1

browse.value: type == 'XCUIElementTypeButton' AND label == 'Browse' AND visible == 1 AND accessible == 1

browse-selected.value: type == 'XCUIElementTypeButton' AND label == 'Browse' AND selected == 1 AND visible == 1 AND accessible == 1

search.value: type == 'XCUIElementTypeButton' AND label == 'Search' AND visible == 1 AND accessible == 1

search-field.value: type == 'XCUIElementTypeSearchField' AND (label == 'Search' OR name == 'Search') AND visible == 1 AND accessible == 1

activate.description: Bring Files to the foreground without opening an item.

open-recents.description: Tap the unique accessible visible Recents control only after readiness shows it is not already selected; verify with recents-selected without selecting an item.

open-browse.description: Tap the unique accessible visible Browse control only after readiness shows it is not already selected; verify with browse-selected without entering a location or folder.

focus-search.description: Tap the unique accessible visible Search button only when search-field is not already visible, then require the field without reading results.

enter-search.description: Enter an explicit caller-supplied term in the visible Files search field and stop without inspecting or opening results.

navigate-recents.description: Launch Files and use state-aware selector readiness to display Recents without selecting or inspecting an item.

navigate-browse.description: Launch Files and use state-aware selector readiness to display the Browse root without traversing a location.

visible-search-only.description: Use Search button/field state readiness, then enter an explicit term for the user to view on the device.

prohibited: enumerating file or folder names, metadata, or contents
traversing local, cloud, external, shared, or third-party provider locations
creating, moving, copying, renaming, tagging, sharing, uploading, downloading, or deleting items
using the More or context menus
safety.uncertain_outcome: A navigation tap or search term may already be visible. Check only the unique selected destination control or visible search-field selector, never source or result rows, before deciding what to do.

host: Appium/XCUITest for navigation and search controls

data_access: visible Files navigation and search control state
explicit search term supplied by the caller
privacy.retention: The integration stores no file names, metadata, content, location list, or search results.
privacy.notes: Search results stay on the iPad display. The integration must not scrape, enumerate, summarize, or transmit them.
